messages:
Elaine (AE): Quick sync on the ACME POC prompts + success criteria. Goal: lock baseline prompt set, eval plan, timeline, and a ballpark pricing note for procurement. They also flagged SSO, data residency, and an audit trail requirement.
Samir (SolutionsEng): Great — can you list the 1-3 concrete product flows they want to validate? prompts count matters for pricing/benchmarks.
Elaine (AE): They sent back three prioritized flows: 1) customer support summarization (extract + rewrite), 2) internal docs search assistant (answer + cite), 3) KYC form autofill (structured output). Expect ~30 unique prompt variants across flows to start.
Marco (ML Eng): For a baseline we should pick one verified open model (quantized) + one higher-capacity variant for accuracy tradeoffs. Proposed baseline prompt snippets:```
# support-summary
SYSTEM: You are a concise support agent.
USER: Summarize the following conversation into a short response that includes the main issue, steps tried, and recommended next step.
# doc-search
SYSTEM: Answer using only the provided documents. If unknown, say "I don't know."
USER: Given these docs, answer the user question and include a citation like [doc-3: section].
# kyc-struct
SYSTEM: Extract fields and return valid JSON with keys: name, dob, id_type, id_number, address.
USER: OCR text: <...>
```
Marco (ML Eng): Also propose an eval harness: 150 gold prompts (50 per flow), automated checks for schema-validity (KY C), citation accuracy (doc-search), and ROUGE/summary overlap + human spot checks for hallucination.
Liz (SE Success): Pricing/ops question — what concurrency and token volumes should we quote for procurement? They want a 2-week POC at ~5k end-users (pilot), ~200 RPS peak. Estimated tokens per request: support=600, doc-search=350, kyc=900.
Marco (ML Eng): With those numbers, baseline capacity suggestion: 4x GPU instances g4-style for steady, allow burst to 8. Cost rough: hosted inference run ~ $0.60–1.20 per 1k tokens depending on model; dedicated reserved capacity estimate will be needed for firm quote. I can run a quick sim if we pick model variants.
Samir (SolutionsEng): Security / compliance checklist — ACME requires: SSO (SAML), customer-managed keys (KMS), logs retention 1 year, and VPC peering option. Any blockers for the POC?
Marco (ML Eng): No technical blockers for POC if we do sanitized data and avoid full PII ingestion. For KMS + VPC we need Private (VPC) deployment which is doable but adds ops lead time (1–2 weeks). Suggest we scope a staged POC: hosted + dedicated fallback, and an option to migrate to Private for production.
infra-bot: DeployBot: Reserved capacity request #R-4821 created for acme-poc; ETA provisioning 3 business days. :gear:
Elaine (AE): Success criteria proposal (POC pass/fail):
- Accuracy: support summaries >= 0.78 ROUGE-L vs gold AND <=2% critical hallucinations (hallucination = false claim about product or policy).
- Doc-search: correct citation rate >= 90% on the eval set.
- KYC: schema validity 100% and field-level exact-match >= 95% for name/dob/id.
- Performance: median response latency < 350ms, p95 < 800ms for baseline model under expected load.
- Ops: SSO + audit logs visible and SAC approval checklist signed.
Samir (SolutionsEng): I'll own the eval harness and run initial runs by Friday. Need ACME subject-matter expert to label 50 golden examples — Elaine can we nudge them?
Elaine (AE): Already asked — they said SME will provide 30 labeled this week, remaining 20 early next.
Liz (SE Success): For procurement slide: I'll put two options: Hosted POC (fast, usage billing) and Dedicated trial (reserved, set monthly price). Need Marco's per-1k-token deltas for the two model tiers to finalize numbers.
Marco (ML Eng): Will run token-cost sim today and post numbers in this thread + a small perf micro-benchmark.
Samir (SolutionsEng): Action items: 1) Marco: perf + cost sim (due EOD) 2) Samir: eval harness skeleton + CSV template for prompt inventory (due Thu) 3) Elaine: get ACME SME labeling schedule + confirm data sanitization plan (due Thu) 4) Liz: procurement slide draft (due Fri).
Elaine (AE): Scheduling a short handoff tomorrow 11:00am PT — invite sent. Agenda: prompt inventory review, confirm success metrics, hand off labeled data process. Link: https://redwood.example.com/r/acme-poc (doc).
Marco (ML Eng): Quick note on prompts: please tag each prompt with expected output type (text/structured/stream) — helps runtime config (KV caching, tokenization).
Samir (SolutionsEng): I'll attach the CSV template after lunch.
Elaine (AE): Thanks all — feel free to drop quick comments here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
